outputs: Function calls in JSON format and natural language responses
The model generates function calls followed by natural language responses in task-oriented dialogues.

quote: We used the 1,000 dialogues in the test split and measured joint goal accuracy (JGA), which measures the percentage of turns for which all slot values are correctly predicted. [...] Our evaluation metrics include JGA for DST and Success rate for the generated response.
